newsitem.title: USA: Textron's Cessna gets $600 million jet order.
newsitem.headline: Textron's Cessna gets $600 million jet order.

text.p: Cessna Aircraft Co. will sell 25 Citation X and 20 Citation VII business jets to Executive Jet Aviation in the largest order ever booked by Wichita, Kan.-based Cessna, the companies said Tuesday.
The companies said it was possibly the largest business jet purchase ever.
Executive Jet is the world's largest commercial operator of business jets with a fleet that includes more than 50 Citation S/IIs and Ultras.
The deal surpasses Executive Jet's purchase of 25 Citation Ultras jets from Cessna, a Textron Inc. unit, in July 1994.
Deliveries are slated to begin next year and will extend into the 21st century, they said.

Montvale, N.J.-based Executive Jet will use the planes in a programme started in 1987 in which customers purchase an ownership stake in a business jet based on the amount of flying they expect to do. The smallest fraction of 12.5 percent affords the owner 100 occupied flight hours per year. Participants pay only for actual flight time.
Cessna is the world's leading producer of business jets, with more than 2,400 Citations operating in 75 countries.
Textron stock rose 12.5 cents to $85.50 on the New York Stock Exchange in late trading.
